title: PRACTICE: Real-World Effectiveness, Safety, and Practical Impact of Afiveg (Aflibercept Biosimilar, Pre-filled Syringes) in Routine Management of Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration and Diabetic Macular Edema: A Prospective Observational Study in Germany
summary: PRACTICE is an observational study conducted in Germany. The aim of this study is to describe the effectiveness, safety, and real-world use of Afiveg (pre-filled syringes) in the routine treatment of patients with neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) or diabetic macular edema (DME). In particular, the study investigates changes in macular retinal thickness, visual acuity, optical coherence tomography (OCT) findings, treatment intervals, treatment adherence, and the experiences of both patients and treating physicians throughout the course of routine clinical care.
conditions: Neovascular Age- Related Macular Degeneration (nAMD, H35.3); Diabetic Macular Edema (DME, H36.0)
Degeneration of macula and posterior pole

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Signed informed consent 
2. Diagnosis of neovascular AMD or DME, made by an ophthalmologist 
3. Adult patients; patients with AMD must be >50 years old and patients with DME ≥18 
years old 
4. Patients for whom the decision to initiate Afiveg treatment has been made as part of routine clinical practice and who meet one of the following criteria: 
a. Treatment-naïve patients initiating anti-VEGF treatment with Afiveg; 
b. Patients with prior anti-VEGF treatment and an insufficient treatment response, as assessed by the investigator, provided they have not received aflibercept-, brolucizumab- or faricimab-containing therapy. 
c. Patients previously treated with Eylea® 2 mg (aflibercept) are eligible provided clinical stability has been documented for at least 3 months (= stability period) prior to V0 
5. Women of childbearing potential must use an effective method of contraception during treatment and for at least 3 months after the last intravitreal injection of Afiveg 
6. Available Data on CRT, presence/absence of intraretinal/subretinal fluid and BCVA for at least one routine visit before study inclusion on the same OCT device that is used for the study 
7. The last injection of the previous anti-VEGF treatment must be more than 4 weeks prior to initiation of Afiveg  
8. Best corrected visual acuity (BCVA) of ≥ 0.05 (decimal) in the study eye at the time of the last routine Visit before V0
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior treatment with Afiveg, other aflibercept biosimilars, faricimab, brolucizumab, Eylea® 8 mg (=114,3 mg/ml formulation) or photodynamic therapy 
2. Planned off-label use of Afiveg 
3. Intraocular surgery within the last 3 months prior to V1 
4. Presence of other retinal or ocular diseases in the study eye that, in the investigator’s judgment, could significantly influence best-corrected visual acuity  
5. Concurrent participation in an ophthalmologic interventional study 
6. Pregnant and/or breastfeeding women 
7. Prior treatment with a systemic anti-VEGF within the last 12 months 
8. Impairment of the fovea of the study eye by fibrosis or geographic atrophy, or total fibrotic area >50% of the total lesion size in the study eye at study inclusion 
9. Any medical or psychological condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, would prevent the patient from completing the 12-month study period
10. Inability to complete the study questionnaires, either independently or with assistance, due to cognitive impairment, insufficient language proficiency, or any other condition that, in the investigator’s judgment, prevents reliable data collection over the 12-month observational period
